\[
P(n) = \sum_{m=1}^n \frac{1}{2^m} P(n - m),
\]

with the boundary condition \( P(0) = 1 \). This recurrence arises because Flora can reach \( n \) by jumping \( m \) from \( n - m \), and the probability of each jump \( m \) is \( \frac{1}{2^m} \).

\]

\]
